whl_tea_owner.text: Welcome, welcome. Scones are fresh, jam is local and the rain outside is not my fault.

then.text: You've had your free cuppa. The second one is a pound, but the biscuits are on the house.

else.text: Here, a cuppa for the road. This village was once on the telly, you know. 'Take the High Road'. Half of Luss was an extra.
